comment: FICTIONAL example rate card for tests and demos. Not a real company or real prices. Unit price by volume band (all-units pricing: the band the whole quantity falls in sets the unit price; each band's upTo is INCLUSIVE, so 499 units is in the lower band and 500 in the next). MOQ is per product with a card flag: steel-bolts refuses below its minimum, nylon-ties re-quotes at the minimum and says so. Small orders (up to 999 units) pay a flat handling fee. GST 18% as a tax line, half-up integer rounding. Coverage: bolts up to 50000 units, ties up to 200000; bigger orders have no covering rule.
label: FICTIONAL: Brightline Fasteners sample rate card (unit price, MOQ, volume tiers, GST)
